info.title: API-DocTest-List Fitness Memberships Billings-v3-spec
info.description: This API allows users to list the billing records for fitness memberships. It provides comprehensive details about membership billing cycles, amounts, and payment statuses. Ideal for fitness center administrators and finance teams, this endpoint streamlines financial tracking and ensures accurate billing management. By accessing this data, users can generate reports, analyze revenue streams, and maintain clear communication with members regarding their billing history.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the billing details associated with memberships. You can use it to check the billing status, upcoming charges, and payment history related to your membership plans.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing information related to memberships. This body should be provided in JSON format and contains the necessary parameters to specify the desired billing information.

ListFitnessMembershipsBillingsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation on memberships billing. This string should contain a valid JSON payload referenced by the API.
